# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a section when the game first draws with 4 of its
# shaders, so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's
# README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
# tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section and has
# patches/shader_survey.c take the game to each map. Section 0 is what every visit draws before the DK Rap, the logos:
# the plan's start ends where the shader survey prints the game's change to the Rap's mode, before the Rap's first
# frame, so the page draws its first frame once those are built. Then "rap", the whole DK Rap, which every visit
# starts (Start in the logos goes to it): its first frame draws 31 of its shaders, which starts the section (RT64
# waits for a section when a frame wants 4), and the rest come one or two a frame. Then "menus", what Start in the Rap
# reaches: a moment of DK TV's Jungle Japes demo, the title, the main menu and its file select, Sound and Options
# screens. Every later section first goes to the main menu with what that draws left out. A recording also puts in
# menus and the later sections the shaders they share with rap and menus, which a visit has built by then; this list
# leaves those out.
# Then a new game through the menus, its opening cutscenes into Training Grounds; Training
# Grounds and DK's house; DK Isles; and a section a world, its lobby and then the world, as a different Kong in
# each, from arriving to a few seconds in, walking, turning the camera, jumping and the pause menu. Seven worlds'
# sections are recorded in a second load too, for places further in where a long play met shaders the world's start
# doesn't draw, each played about 25 s (walking out and back, jumps, attacks, Z with C-down and with B, the camera
# turned) as the Kong the survey puts there: Aztec's Llama temple, its Dogadon and the beetle race; Mad Jack, and
# Factory's DK Arcade and Jetpac (Cranky's, any world's), watched; Galleon's lighthouse, the mermaid's palace and
# Pufftoss; Fungi's giant mushroom and its Dogadon; Crystal Caves' ice castle and Army Dillo; Castle's museum and King
# Kut Out; K. Rool's fight with DK, in Helm's; and Kremling Kosh, a bonus barrel's minigame, watched, in Japes'. Not recorded: the other bosses, bonus
# barrels and minigames, Kong Battle, and what else a world draws further in (RT64 builds those when the game first
# asks for them, and the page remembers them for the next visit). The last
# section, "earlier", holds what the list had before it was recorded this way that this recording didn't meet.
# The last three of japes, the last of aztec and the last two of castle are what tools/play_plan_extended.json drew beyond the
# list in those levels.
# Flags follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording
# again.
